_comment: Logic tuning. 'battle_logic' gates each area behind a share of the medaparts in the item pool so that the player is plausibly strong enough; the share grows linearly from 0 in the first area to final_parts_fraction in the last.

trap_strength._comment: Per trap, one value per strength. money_drain: percent of money lost. rusty_armor: percent of armor kept during the next battle. medal_nap and ambush: how many battles / encounters it lasts.
